front: What's the exact CLI flag (and Agent SDK option name) that caps a print-mode run's API spend in dollars, and does subagent spend count toward it?
back: `--max-budget-usd <amount>` (print mode only); Agent SDK: `maxBudgetUsd` (TypeScript) / `max_budget_usd` (Python). Spend from subagents counts toward the cap. Once the cap is reached, spawning another subagent fails with `Budget limit reached` and any background subagents still running are stopped. There is no `settings.json` key for this — it's a per-run flag/option only.

front: In an `--output-format json` (or Agent SDK) result message, what `subtype` values distinguish why a run ended, and what does each mean?
back: `"success"` — finished normally. `"error_max_turns"` — hit `--max-turns`/`maxTurns`. `"error_max_budget_usd"` — hit `--max-budget-usd`/`maxBudgetUsd`. `"error_during_execution"` — an unrelated failure during the run. `"error_max_structured_output_retries"` — exhausted structured-output retries. Read `subtype` before deciding which knob to adjust.

front: What does `--strict-mcp-config` do, and why pair it with `--mcp-config` in CI?
back: It restricts the session to only the MCP servers passed via `--mcp-config`, ignoring every other MCP configuration source (project `.mcp.json`, user settings, plugin-provided servers, claude.ai connectors). Pairing them makes a CI run's MCP setup reproducible regardless of what's configured on the runner machine.

front: In the Agent SDK, what does `settingSources: []` do, and what's the default if you don't set it?
back: `settingSources: []` disables the user, project, and local filesystem settings sources (and CLAUDE.md), so only options passed explicitly in code apply — endpoint-managed policy still loads regardless. Left unset, it defaults to loading the same sources the CLI would (all of them), so an SDK app is NOT settings-isolated by default; you must opt out.
